about.text: Role: sustainability lead. Question: how much embodied carbon (A1-A3) does each storey carry per square metre of floor, so storeys of different size compare fairly? Carbon is summed per storey from nrc_analytics_elements.csv (synthetic); floor area is the sum of the IfcSpace areas on that storey (PSet_Revit_Dimensions Area, net room area, m2) read from the enriched Duplex; the ratio is kgCO2e/m2. Honest absence: T/FDN (the foundation) has 11,761.3 kgCO2e but no spaces, so its intensity stays missing, never zero; it shows gray in 3D and as 'no floor area' in the Vega-Lite figure. Roof's area is one space named Roof (145.7 m2, the attic volume Revit modelled as a room), so its 39.9 kgCO2e/m2 measures the attic, not a living floor. The IFCROOF element has no carbon value: ElementsWithCarbon counts 7 of Roof's 8 elements. Living floors: Level 2 362.0 and Level 1 348.8 kgCO2e/m2. The 'Whole building' table sums every storey's carbon (EmbodiedCarbon_kgCO2e, foundation included) and, separately, the carbon of only the storeys that have spaces; its intensity divides that second sum by their floor area, so the foundation's carbon is left out of the ratio rather than spread over an area it does not have: 115,730.3 kgCO2e in all, of which 103,969.0 kgCO2e sits on the 3 storeys with 422.0 m2 of space, 246.3 kgCO2e/m2. Bars: storeys ranked by intensity on one viridis scale; 3D: every element tinted with its storey's intensity on the same scale.

storeyCarbon.aggregates: sum(EmbodiedCarbon_A1A3_kgCO2e) as EmbodiedCarbon_kgCO2e,count(*) as Elements,count(EmbodiedCarbon_A1A3_kgCO2e) as ElementsWithCarbon

spaces.sql: SELECT e.GlobalId, e.StepId, e.Name, st.StepId AS StoreyEntityId, s.StoreyName AS Storey, TRY_CAST(p.Value AS DOUBLE) AS Area_m2 FROM EntityText e JOIN StoreyOfElement s ON s.EntityIndex = e.EntityIndex AND s.Depth = 1 JOIN EntityText st ON st.EntityIndex = s.StoreyIndex LEFT JOIN ParameterText p ON p.EntityIndex = e.EntityIndex AND p.Name = 'Area' AND p.ParameterGroup = 'PSet_Revit_Dimensions' WHERE e.Category = 'IFCSPACE' ORDER BY st.StepId, e.StepId

storeyArea.aggregates: sum(Area_m2) as FloorArea_m2,count(*) as Spaces,count(Area_m2) as SpacesWithArea

areaBasis.name: AreaBasis
areaBasis.expr: isnull(FloorArea_m2) ? 'no spaces: intensity missing' : 'net space area'

chart.title: Embodied carbon intensity per storey (kgCO2e/m2 of space, synthetic carbon); T/FDN has no floor area

storeyTable.title: Carbon, floor area, and intensity per storey

building.aggregates: sum(EmbodiedCarbon_kgCO2e) as EmbodiedCarbon_kgCO2e,sum(CarbonOnStoreysWithSpaces_kgCO2e) as CarbonOnStoreysWithSpaces_kgCO2e,sum(FloorArea_m2) as FloorArea_m2,count(*) as Storeys,count(FloorArea_m2) as StoreysWithSpaces

buildingTable.title: Whole building: all carbon, and the intensity of the storeys that have spaces
